notes.mask: Saved mask is palette-colored RGB, not the internal integer class map. OpenCV reads it in BGR order.
notes.overlay: Overlay is saturated uint8 addition of the original image and 0.8 times the colored mask.
notes.lossy: JPEG inputs cause JPEG outputs; compression prevents exact palette matching. PNG was observed in the probe.
notes.overwrite: The source increments its counter once per single_beetles folder, not once per image. Multiple inputs with the same extension in one folder overwrite each other.
notes.scope: Tested 5-class checkpoint. The hard-coded six-color palette is not a validated 9-class export.
notes.representation: Structure describes two output directories. Each maps <folder-index>.<input-extension> filenames to raster files. Decoded RGB pixels have type T[image]: original_height rows, original_width pixels per row, three integer channels (0 through 255). These are files, not a JSON object.
